title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Closed Beta Feedback Update
summary: See how Closed Beta feedback is shaping EA SPORTS FC™ 27, from gameplay improvements to our approach to early updates

sections.title: Introduction
sections.summary: During the EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Closed Beta, we heard your feedback across the game through the EA Closed Beta Forums, the FC 27 Closed Beta Player Feedback Portal, and Discord. We’ve been reviewing that feedback to better understand your experience and the…

sections.title: Early Gameplay Title Update Strategy
sections.summary: We’ve been closely following player conversations and know there’s feedback about significant gameplay balance changes being made after launch. For EA SPORTS FC™ 27, we want to take a measured approach and do not plan on making significant gameplay balance…

sections.title: Bruiser & Shoulder Challenge Improvements
sections.summary: Physical play and the Bruiser PlayStyle have been big topics coming out of the EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Closed Beta. We still want physical play to be a viable way to win the ball while defending, but we’ve made some changes to make Shoulder Challenges more…

sections.title: Team Press & Defensive Depth
sections.summary: Team Press is intended to be a way to apply pressure higher up the pitch, but we found it was also too effective when used close to your own goal. In those situations, AI teammates could automatically close down opponents and take too much of the defensive…

sections.title: AcceleRATE Update
sections.summary: Based on your feedback during the Closed Beta, we’ve looked at AcceleRATE itself as well as some of the other mechanics that were contributing to Lengthy players being particularly effective. As previously announced in the FC 27 Gameplay Deep Dive, Triggered…

sections.title: Player Lock Changes
sections.summary: We heard your feedback that Player Lock could be particularly effective with very little downside for an advanced mechanic. Based on that feedback, we’ve made some changes to introduce more of a risk-reward balance when using Player Lock.

sections.title: Dinked Pass Update
sections.summary: As previously announced in the Gameplay Deep Dive, Dinked Passes are fully manual in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Previously, Ground Pass and Through Pass could trigger different versions of the Dinked Pass, one toward a teammate and one into space.

sections.title: Player Roles & Attacking Spatial Awareness
sections.summary: We’ve seen questions from the community about how the new Attacking Spatial Awareness system works alongside Player Roles. Player Roles continue to determine the types of runs a player can make based on their position and Role.

sections.title: Corner Kicks: What’s New in FC 27?
sections.summary: We’ve seen questions around what is actually different about Corner Kicks in FC 27 since you could already control a player in the box in FC 26. While FC 26 gave you the ability to manually control a player in the box, the main difference with corners in FC…

sections.title: Authentic Gameplay
sections.summary: Based on the feedback from the FC 27 Closed Beta, we’re making several refinements to CPU AI in Authentic Gameplay. In line with our approach to early gameplay updates, these changes are focused on targeted adjustments rather than significantly changing the…

sections.title: Other Closed Beta Feedback
sections.summary: We also received a lot of feedback across The Grounds, Clubs, Career Mode, PC, and Football Ultimate Team™ during the Closed Beta. For The Grounds, Clubs, and Career Mode, we’ve seen and are continuing to review your feedback.
